ruleName: Relief for Ball in Penalty Area
title: No Room to Drop from a Yellow Penalty Area
question: Your ball lies in a yellow penalty area near a steep cliff. You want to take back-on-the-line relief, but there is nowhere you can drop a ball on that line without being closer to the hole. What are your options?

choices.text: Drop at the nearest place where you can stand safely.
Drop on the opposite side of the penalty area.
You cannot take back-on-the-line relief. You must either play the ball as it lies (if possible) or return to where you played your previous stroke under stroke and distance.
Take free relief because there is nowhere to drop.

explanation: For a yellow penalty area, you have two options for relief under penalty: stroke and distance (play again from the original spot), or back-on-the-line relief (dropping on a line from the hole through where the ball last crossed the edge of the area). If there is nowhere behind the penalty area where you can drop without being nearer the hole, only these options are available. You must either play the ball as it lies (if possible), or take stroke-and-distance relief. There is no free relief and you cannot drop simply where convenient.
